pages.title: Gear Expansion
pages.text:
Gear Expansion adds new materials, each with tools, armor, and a shield. Every material plays differently, and wearing a full set gives a set bonus.

Strong effects are kept in check by meters, cooldowns, and costs, and nearly every number can be changed in the settings.

pages.title: Using This Book
pages.text:
**Materials** has a page for every material: how to get it, what its gear does, its set bonus, and its recipes.

**Alloy Forge** explains the workstation that makes Brass and Rose Gold.

Hover over an entry to see what it covers.
